criteria.statement: The web app exposes Fleet Health as an obvious Operations navigation destination and protects it like other authenticated operations routes.
Fleet Health computes fleet weather lanes, summary counts, dominant pressure signals, and active cleanup state from real worker and cleanup read models.
Cleanup requests use encrypted ContextVM worker/cleanup mutation intent and carry operator source metadata without introducing a public command kind.
Bahia publishes cleanup lifecycle as canonical kind 30900 state with schema bahia.state.worker-cleanup.v1 and verifies relay acceptance.
